evidence: Across 4,614 paired adults, the survey-weighted automatic-minus-manual mean was -1.50 mmHg. At 130 mmHg, 5.32% moved above and 8.15% moved below the cutoff.
next_decision: For a surveillance trend crossing the protocol change, publish weighted directional switches and uncertainty alongside the series; use held-out error to choose any bridge.
boundary: The device and examiner change together. Weighted results describe adults with paired examination records; threshold crossings are survey classifications, not new clinical diagnoses.
